_about: Generated by `python -m jax_scout.registry --export`; do not edit.

substrates.name: etdrk4-sncgl
substrates.doc:
Phase C / C1 / C2 S-NCGL on the fixed ETDRK4 (jax_scout/physics.py, e270cdc). params = the physics
param dict (param_D, param_eta, param_a, ... ; kinetic_mode='conservative' + param_geom_off for the C2
NLS branch). Fields: psi.

substrates.name: kg-strang
substrates.doc:
C3 complex nonlinear Klein-Gordon, Strang split with exact linear rotation
(jax_scout/phase_d_c3_wave.py:kg_evolve). params: c, m, a, s, f. Fields: psi, pi.

substrates.name: tg-rk4
substrates.doc:
TG dual substrate: KG field + temporal T + geometric G, RK4
(jax_scout/gravity_TG_B1S_state_load_feedback_gpu.py:rk4_step). params: the TG cfg keys (c, m, a, s, f,
alpha_T, omega_T, omega_G, gamma_T, gamma_G, kappa_TG, epsilon_G, cT, cG, absorb_width,
absorb_strength, core_radius) plus optional flags [source, temporal, geometric, feedback] and refs.
Fields: phi, pi, T, G.

ics.name: load_npz
ics.doc: Fields from a saved .npz (e.g. a settled a* state). params: path, key (default psi_fin).

ics.name: multiseed
ics.doc:
Phase C K-blob IC (core_saturation_search.build_ic, the a* harnesses' own).
Requires grid L = 10 (the harness constant).

ics.name: nls_soliton
ics.doc:
Exact conservative-branch soliton by Petviashvili (phase_d_c2_3_exact_soliton.petviashvili,
the C2.3/C2.7 harnesses' own), optionally Galilean-boosted by exp(i k x) with k = 2*pi*boost_n / L.
etdrk4-sncgl with kinetic_mode='conservative' only; grid L must be 10 (the harness constant).

ics.name: qball
ics.doc:
Stationary Q-ball by Petviashvili (phase_d_c3_wave.qball_petviashvili) for the
substrate's (a, s, f); KG convention: omega = sqrt(m² - mu), pi = -i·omega·psi; optional configurational
kick v along x: pi -= v·∂x psi.

observers.name: centroid
observers.doc:
Periodic (circular-mean) centroid of |psi|² along x, y, z
(phase_d_c3_wave.centroid_x); unwrapped across the box so velocities can be fitted.

observers.name: energy_ratio
observers.doc:
er = Σ|psi|² / Σ|psi_0|² on raw grid sums (the a* harnesses' er(t),
core_saturation_search.evaluate_candidate).

observers.name: kg_invariants
observers.doc:
KG energy E, U(1) charge Q, momentum Px, mass, amp
(phase_d_c3_wave.invariants). kg-strang only. Also Q_rel_drift / E_rel_drift vs t=0.

observers.name: mass
observers.doc: mass = ∫|psi|² dV; mass_ratio = mass / mass at t=0.

observers.name: nodes
observers.doc: Number of nodes (transfer_diag.detect_nodes: rho > mean + NODE_SIGMA·std, labelled).

observers.name: tg_diagnostics
observers.doc:
All TG-B1S diagnostics (energies, charge, node position/width, T/G at the
node, source/damping/boundary rates). tg-rk4 only.
